source_id: EL-UC-001 Main Success Scenario
purpose: Verify the main success flow for EL-UC-001 â€” Apply for Leave.
preconditions: The actors, configured policy/hierarchy, and prerequisite records described by the specification are available.
action_or_input: M1. Employee starts a new leave application. M2. Employee selects the leave category and requested period and enters purpose/reason and other required information. M3. System captures Station Leave details in the same application when applicable. M4. System validates category eligibility, entitlement/balance, counting/calendar conditions, and impermissible overlap. M5. When responsibility coverage is required, Employee nominates one eligible substitute. M6. Employee submits the application. M7. If substitute consent is required, System places the request in Awaiting Substitute Response; otherwise it routes the request to Unit Head review. A Director-applicant follows the self-sanction path.
expected_result: The use case completes according to its specified main success scenario for EL-UC-001.

purpose: Verify the main success flow for EL-UC-002 â€” Respond to Substitute Request.

purpose: Verify the main success flow for EL-UC-003 â€” Review Leave-Related Request at Unit Head.

action_or_input: M1. Unit Head opens the assigned request and reviews the request context and available supporting information. M2. For a new CL/RH request, Unit Head records final Approve or Reject. source_id: EL-UC-005 Main Success Scenario
purpose: Verify the main success flow for EL-UC-005 â€” Make Final Sanctioning Decision.
preconditions: The actors, configured policy/hierarchy, and prerequisite records described by the specification are available.
action_or_input: M1. Authority opens the assigned request and reviews the request, recommendation, and available evidence. M2. Authority records Approve or Reject. M3. System records the final decision and notifies the employee. M4. For new-leave approval, System updates the leave record/account. M5. For cancellation approval, System marks the leave Cancelled and restores/adjusts deducted balance; cancellation rejection preserves the original approval. M6. For extension approval, System posts only the incremental additional period; extension rejection preserves the original approved leave.
expected_result: The use case completes according to its specified main success scenario for EL-UC-005.
